scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I'm the most skillful blacksmith!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
我是技术最精湛的铁匠！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I am the best Armsmith ever!
I don't refine normal, boring items.
I only refine items that are Level 10 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
我是有史以来最伟大的武器匠！
我不精炼那些普通、乏味的物品。
我只精炼+10或以上的物品。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Anyway, you may use my services if your item is Level 10 or higher.
What do you want me to refine?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
总之，如果你的物品是+10或以上，就可以使用我的服务。
你想让我精炼什么？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hmm a weapon, is that ok?
If you want to refine this weapon,
I will need 1 ^003366{0}^000000 and {1} zeny.
Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
嗯，是武器啊？
要精炼这把武器，需要1个^003366{0}^000000和{1} Zeny。
确定要继续吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hmm a weapon, is that ok?
If you want to refine this weapon,
I will need 1 ^003366{0}^000000 and {1} zeny.
Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
嗯，是武器啊？
要精炼这把武器，需要1个^003366{0}^000000和{1} Zeny。
确定要继续吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hmm an armor, is that ok?
If you want to refine this armor,
I will need 1 ^003366{0}^000000 and {1} zeny.
Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
嗯，是防具啊？
要精炼这件防具，需要1个^003366{0}^000000和{1} Zeny。
确定要继续吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hmm an armor, is that ok?
If you want to refine this armor,
I will need 1 ^003366{0}^000000 and {1} zeny.
Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
嗯，是防具啊？
要精炼这件防具，需要1个^003366{0}^000000和{1} Zeny。
确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
This weapon already has been refined several times.
It could be destroyed if I try again.
It won't break for sure, but there is has a small chance.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
这把武器已经精炼过好几次了。
再试的话可能会损坏。
虽然不一定会坏，但还是有一定风险。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
This armor already has been refined several times.
It could be destroyed if I try again.
It won't break for sure, but there is has a small chance.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
这件防具已经精炼过好几次了。
再试的话可能会损坏。
虽然不一定会坏，但还是有一定风险。

scripts.text: Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!
scripts.translation: 铛！铛！铛！铛！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You could be ^FF0000lowering the upgrade level^000000 of the weapon,
or if it breaks, you will lose ^FF0000any cards^000000 or special properties added to it.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
武器的^FF0000精炼等级可能会下降^000000；
如果精炼失败，^FF0000卡片^000000和附加的特殊属性也会一并消失。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You could be ^FF0000lowering the upgrade level^000000 of the armor,
or if it breaks, you will lose ^FF0000any cards^000000 or special properties added to it.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
防具的^FF0000精炼等级可能会下降^000000；
如果精炼失败，^FF0000卡片^000000和附加的特殊属性也会一并消失。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Clang! Clang! Clang!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
铛！铛！铛！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
铛！铛！铛！铛！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Do you still want me to refine it?
I think I have given you enough warning.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你还要我继续精炼吗？
我想我已经给了你足够的警告。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hmmm!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
嗯！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Ahhh!!!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
啊！！！

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh my! I've failed to refine stuff...
I didn't mean it!
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
It just wasn't meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哎呀，精炼失败了...我不是故意的！
就算我是天下第一的武器匠，也难免失手。
唉，天意如此。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh my god!
The upgrade level has dropped...
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
It just wasn't meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
天哪！精炼等级下降了...
就算我是天下第一的武器匠，也难免失手。
唉，天意如此。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't think I can refine any items you have...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
我觉得你身上没有我可以精炼的物品...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't think I can
refine this item at all...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
这件物品恐怕没法精炼...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I said I don't work with items that are lower than Level 10.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
我说过，我不处理低于+10的物品。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You're not wearing
anything there that
I can refine.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你没穿戴可以精炼的装备。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I can't refine this
any more. This is as
refined as it gets!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
已经不能再精炼了，这是最高精炼等级！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hm... if you mind... never mind...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
嗯...如果你介意的话...算了...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hm. You don't seem to have enough money or {0}.
Please come back when you have them.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
嗯，你的钱或{0}似乎不够。
备齐之后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
等一下...
你觉得我傻吗？！
趁我不注意你换了物品！给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Good! Succes!!!
I am the best Armsmith.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
好！成功！！！
我是最伟大的武器匠。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Well, no challenge is one way to go...
No risk... that could be wise.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
好吧，不冒险也是一种选择...
求个稳妥，或许才明智。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I will do a better job next time! Don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
下次我会做得更好！别担心！

[Austri]
If you bring me 3
Oridecon or Elunium
I can exchange them for
Bradium or Carnium.
Just give me 50,000z.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
带3个神之金属或铝，再付50,000 Zeny，就能换成魔力之石或混沌金属。

scripts.text: Oridecon to Bradium.
scripts.translation: 神之金属换魔力之石

scripts.text: Elunium to Carnium.

My cool dad Holink said I have the world's greatest refine hammer!!
Meow Meow~
Who do you think I am?
Yes!!! You!! You want to refine?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
我那帅气的爸爸霍林克说，我有世界上最棒的精炼锤！！
喵喵~你以为我是谁？
对！！！就是你！想精炼吗？
